title: Create: Mayday!
description: A fun Create focused server, with unique mechinics, economy, world gen, and players!
body: This server is open to all! With our main mods being **Create** and **Create: Aeronautics**, players should be set on exploring the world. With unique biomes and terrian, it offers a perspective for building and traveling not seen anywhere else! Please join the community server for help, and community!
